provenance: Fresh hand-authored synthetic challenge cases, labelled before either baseline or exact-symbol trial runs. Covers qualified names, duplicate names and paths, multiple names, unresolved names, prose and a relevant callee memory. Not independently labelled real-session holdout data.

memories.title: Interchange commitment
memories.body: External consumers require a trailing newline after each serialized record.

memories.title: Spreadsheet interoperability
memories.body: Escape embedded delimiters using doubled quotation marks.

memories.title: Availability sampling
memories.body: The monitoring probe must remain allocation free.

queries.question: Which constraint applies to JsonWriter.encode_payload?
queries.rationale: Only the explicitly qualified writer's serialization contract applies.

queries.question: Which constraints apply to the encode_payload implementations?
queries.rationale: The unqualified method has two implementations; both serialization contracts are relevant.

memories.title: Wire compatibility
memories.body: The public protocol requires the original field ordering for older clients.

memories.title: Batch transfer policy
memories.body: Internal jobs use compressed blocks at rest.

memories.title: Probe latency budget
memories.body: Availability checks must finish without contacting external dependencies.

queries.question: Which constraint applies to encode_payload in api/codec.py?
queries.rationale: The explicit file path selects the public codec rather than the worker codec.

queries.question: Which constraints apply to encode_payload in codec.py?
queries.rationale: The basename matches two files; both contracts remain possible.

memories.title: Ingress compatibility
memories.body: Legacy senders include the eight byte prefix in every frame.

memories.title: Egress compatibility
memories.body: Downstream consumers require the fixed width prefix.

memories.title: Diagnostic display
memories.body: Support tooling expects the binary label verbatim.

queries.question: Which constraints apply to read_header and write_header?
queries.rationale: Both explicitly named framing functions have independent compatibility requirements.

queries.question: Which constraints apply to read_header and missing_header?
queries.rationale: The known function's decision remains relevant; the unknown name must not be treated as a resolved declaration.

queries.question: What compatibility requirements govern incoming and outgoing frames?
queries.rationale: The question refers to framing behavior without naming declarations; both compatibility decisions are relevant.

memories.title: Peer session lifetime
memories.body: The peer's connection lease expires after one minute. Longer pauses abandon the session.

queries.question: Why does send_packet cap the backoff at sixty seconds?
queries.rationale: The named caller delegates its timing to backoff_delay; the callee's lease constraint explains the caller's behavior.
